address.heading: Where to join
address.addressHtml: At the time of your interview, please join the Zoom meeting via the link located in your Google Calendar invitation. If you do not see a link, please reach out to your Recruiting Coordinator.

paragraphs.html: Find a quiet, private space with good lighting. Confirm the Zoom link is working — we recommend downloading the desktop application. Test your camera, microphone, speakers and internet connection ahead of time. Close extra tabs or applications to avoid notifications or lag.
Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the link provided by your Recruiting Coordinator.
You will be automatically placed in a waiting room and will need to be admitted by the first interviewer. If you leave the session at any time, you will need to be admitted again.
The use of Zoom AI features or any personal recording, transcription, or automated note-taking tools during live interviews is not permitted at this time.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
